description: This PHP source file provides a web interface for resetting and restoring a network gateway device. It includes HTML and JavaScript for user interactions, confirmation dialogs, and AJAX calls to perform reset and restore actions, as well as associated UI components.

methods.name: setResetInfo
methods.description: Sends AJAX request to initiate reset or restore operations based on user confirmation.

methods.name: checkForRebooting
methods.description: Checks if the device has rebooted by querying index.php and redirects to login page when reboot is complete.
